items.title: RoboTrack: Point tracking for real-world robotic manipulation
items.reader_summary: Deploying robots in real-world settings requires reliable perception throughout an interaction. To pick something up, a robot needs to follow the positions of its gripper and the object as they move. In a laboratory, a robot handling a pipette must keep track of its tip while aligning it with the opening of a tube. These tasks become harder when nearby objects clutter the view, the gripper obscures the object being handled, or the viewing angle changes.
items.summary_zh: 在真實世界環境中部署機器人，需要在整個互動過程中具備可靠的感知能力。為了撿起某樣東西，機器人需要追蹤其夾爪和物件在移動時的位置。在實驗室中，處理移液器的機器人必須在追蹤其尖端的同時，將其與試管口對齊。當鄰近物件幹擾視線、夾爪遮擋了正在處理的物件，或是視角改變時，這些任務會變得更加困難。

items.title: Anthropic推出Claude Ship，AI自動審查、修正及核准程式碼
items.summary: Anthropic週一（11/23）宣佈推出Claude Ship，將AI程式開發的自動化範圍從撰寫程式碼延伸至軟體交付流程，讓AI能夠自動審查及修正程式碼，甚至依據企業的自定政策來核准程式碼的變更，目前開放Claude Team及Enterprise使用者測試。 隨著愈來愈多開發人員使用AI代理人撰寫程式碼，後續的人工審查及核准流程可能成為軟體開發的瓶頸。Anthropic表示，旗下Claude Code團隊的大部分程式碼已由Claude撰寫，為了加快提交程式碼後的處理流程，開發了Claude Ship。

items.title: 美國總務署在既有身分驗證智慧卡上成功執行抗量子密碼演算法

items.title: 雲端服務Rackspace Spot遭入侵，攻擊者可讀取客戶叢集內的機密資料
items.summary: Rackspace託管式Kubernetes平臺Spot憑證遭外洩，攻擊者在部分客戶組織冒用合法使用者身分，得以在客戶叢集建立未經授權的Pod、讀取Kubernetes Secrets，以及列出叢集節點與儲存磁區。Rackspace接獲客戶通報後確認遭到入侵，平臺隨後暫停存取並清理環境，造成管理主控臺長時間無法使用，客戶也無法管理叢集或輪替可能遭暴露的憑證，直到臺灣時間11月22日凌晨才恢復服務。

items.title: OpenAI updates ChatGPT to handle complex everyday questions, web searches, and images more reliably
items.summary: OpenAI is making GPT-6.2 Sol the new default model in ChatGPT's chat tab, rolling it out worldwide. In internal tests, image understanding jumped from 47.4 to 71.7 percent, and the model now handles difficult instructions correctly 78.1 percent of the time. It also sticks to safety policies more consistently. The article OpenAI updates ChatGPT to handle complex everyday questions, web searches, and images more reliably appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 正在將 GPT-6.2 Sol 設為 ChatGPT's 對話標籤頁中的全新預設模型，並正向全球推出。在內部測試中，影像理解能力從 47.4% 躍升至 71.7%，且該模型現在能正確處理困難指令的比率達到 78.1%。它也更一致地遵守安全政策。

items.title: Anthropic's appetite for compute is pushing xAI toward a rent-over-build strategy
items.summary: Since May, SpaceXSI has been renting compute to competitors like Anthropic and Google while scaling back its own AI projects. Anthropic pays about $3.1 billion a month, Google $800 million, the New York Times reports. After its June IPO, SpaceXSI disbanded the 60-person Grok Imagine team, among other cuts. The article Anthropic's appetite for compute is pushing xAI toward a rent-over-build strategy appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 《紐約時報》報導，自 5 月以來，SpaceXSI 一邊縮減自身的 AI 專案規模，一邊將算力租給 Anthropic 和 Google 等競爭對手。Anthropic 每月支付約 31 億美元，Google 則支付 8.0 億美元。在 6 月份的首次公開募股（IPO）之後，SpaceXSI 解散了擁有 60 人的 Grok Imagine 團隊，並進行了其他裁員。

items.title: OpenAI warns that upcoming AI systems could outpace safety checks and urges rivals to agree on shared limits
items.summary: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki has released internal perplexity scores for the entire GPT series for the first time, up to an unreleased model beyond the current generation. The metric shows that core capabilities emerge at surprisingly precise thresholds. Pachocki is pushing to make perplexity an industry-wide progress metric and establish shared limits before control over AI behavior erodes. The article OpenAI warns that upcoming AI systems could outpace safety checks and urges rivals to agree on shared limits appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 首席科學家 Jakub Pachocki 首次發布了整個 GPT 系列（包含一個超越當前世代的未發布模型）的內部困惑度（perplexity）分數。該指標顯示核心能力會在令人驚訝的精確閾值處浮現。Pachocki 正積極推動將困惑度訂為全產業的進度指標，並在對 AI 行為的控制力消逝之前建立共同的限制。

items.title: Z.ai follows OpenAI into loop transformer territory with its new 750B flagship model
items.summary: Z.ai is moving its flagship GLM-5.4 model to a loop architecture in which 28 layers run twice, which the company says lets the 750-billion-parameter model match models with 2 to 3 trillion parameters. Benchmark scores are only available for a smaller 30B test model so far, and Z.ai is positioning GLM-5.4 as the start of "Generalized Coding," where code also generates videos, games, and CAD models. The article Z.ai follows OpenAI into loop transformer territory with its new 750B flagship model appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 智譜 正在將其旗艦 GLM-5.4 模型轉移到循環架構中，其中 28 層會執行兩次，該公司表示這讓這個擁有 7,500 億參數的模型能夠匹敵擁有 2 兆到 3 兆參數的模型。目前基準測試分數僅適用於較小的 30B 測試模型，且 智譜 正將 GLM-5.4 定位為「廣義編碼（Generalized Coding）」的開端，程式碼在此也能生成影片、遊戲和 CAD 模型。

items.title: US spies tracked Nvidia scandal figure's ties to Chinese intelligence for over a year
items.summary: US intelligence agencies tracked contacts between Alice Huang and China's Ministry of State Security for over a year, the New York Times reports. The surveillance ran parallel to her secret affair with then-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. Federal investigators are now looking into whether a network of companies in Southeast Asia was used to smuggle AI chips into China in violation of US export controls. Jensen Huang is scheduled to testify before the US House of Representatives on December 1. The article US spies tracked Nvidia scandal figure's ties to Chinese intelligence for over a year appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 《紐約時報》報導，美國情報機構追蹤愛麗絲・黃（Alice Huang）與中國國家安全部的接觸已超過一年。這項監控與她當時和輝達執行長黃仁勳的祕密戀情同時進行。聯邦調查局（FBI）目前正在調查東南亞的一個公司網路是否被用來走私 AI 晶片至中國，以違反美國出口管制。黃仁勳預定於 12 月 1 日向美國眾議院作證。

items.title: GPT-6.2 Astra solved a math theorem no other AI could crack, then invented its own proof strategy
items.summary: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra independently produced a machine-verifiable Lean proof of Smoktunowicz's gap theorem, the first of its kind according to Vals AI. The model chose its own approach because key foundations were missing from Mathlib. On Autoform-Hard, Astra now leads the leaderboard with 49 of 56 tasks solved. The article GPT-6.2 Astra solved a math theorem no other AI could crack, then invented its own proof strategy appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra 獨立產出了斯莫克圖諾維奇 (Smoktunowicz) 間隙定理的機器可驗證 Lean 證明，根據 Vals AI 的說法，這是同類中的首創。由於 Mathlib 缺少關鍵基礎，該模型選擇了自己的方法。在 Autoform-Hard 上，Astra 目前以解決 56 個任務中的 49 個領先排行榜。

items.title: 螞蟻OceanBase發佈經營數據：AI與全球化成爲新增長點，海外營收同比增長超100%
items.summary: 11月24日，螞蟻OceanBase在北京舉辦AI數據大會，披露2026年經營進展。公司加速邁向AI數據平臺，保持強勁增長，近五年營收復合增長率超60%，增長結構更多元：金融政企核心業務穩定支撐，AI與全球化貢獻新增量，公有云成重要引擎。其AI業務營收超1億元，居國內獨立廠商前列，海外業務亦持續拓展。

items.title: 從“問答”到“辦事”：豆包推出AI個人助理“小豆”，用對話式交互終結日常瑣事焦慮
items.summary: 現代人被查快遞、回消息、記日程等碎片化瑣事淹沒，亟需能理解意圖、主動辦事的AI數字分身。近日，豆包旗下AI個人助理“小豆”開啓邀請制公測，用戶憑邀請碼可體驗並獲專屬免費額度。此舉不僅是新品上線，更標誌AI應用從被動“信息檢索”邁向主動“動手辦事”。

items.title: MiniMax H3 開源百日交卷：一個模型裂變成 1472 個，下載量突破 1.48 億次
items.summary: 開源100天，MiniMax H3交出生態成績單：1個H3衍生出1472個模型，對應1472種需求與用法，總下載量超1.48億次，平均每秒超17次，新模型仍在湧現。MiniMax將其總結為H3Family，宣佈持續開源，致力打造AI時代多模態創作代表性社群。H3已成為連線愛好者、開發者與商業公司的新起點。

items.title: 螞蟻OceanBase發佈AI數據平臺:統一管理多模態數據，爲Agent提供業務上下文
items.summary: 11月24日，螞蟻OceanBase AI數據大會在京舉行。CEO楊冰稱，模型與Agent基建成熟後，挑戰將回歸數據，AI時代數據基礎設施應堅持“湖庫一體、多模融合、Agent友好、開源開放”。會上，OceanBase發佈湖庫一體AI數據平臺OceanLake，並宣佈向全球開源核心引擎AI數據庫，邀開發者和產業夥伴共建。

items.title: Demo 剛公開就被抄上小程序：一款用AI開發獨遊靠中國玩家扳回兩局
items.summary: 2025年10月，一個不會編程、畫畫的年輕人用AI做遊戲，首條指令是“做一個能用WASD移動的方塊遊戲”。一年後，其一人團隊Optima Arch的《轉運軍團》（slotbound）爆賣：11月13日42元首發九折，6天銷量破20萬套，銷售額近千萬，1800多條評測約80%好評，最高同時在線3.3萬。商店頁坦承視覺與宣傳物料由AI生成，呈現“AI畫皮、人寫骨”模式。

items.title: 黃仁勳官復原職：英偉達董事會一週內戲劇性逆轉，股價應聲大漲 31%
items.summary: 英偉達圍繞最高權力的拉鋸不到一週徹底反轉。董事會一致投票通過，恢復黃仁勳總裁、CEO及董事職務；消息公佈後，公司股價隨即大漲31%。而幾天前，董事長哈維·瓊斯還向投資者明確表示，董事會無意讓黃仁勳迴歸。董事會解釋，促成逆轉的是幾股力量同時到位，後續會談讓他們對黃仁勳的態度發生改變。

items.title: OpenAI 攜手思科開源 Shirudo：給 AI 智能體系統裝上“不打烊的防彈衣”
items.summary: 針對漏洞爆發至補丁落地間的防護真空期，OpenAI於11月24日聯合思科推出開源項目Shirudo。它是一款開源Linux運行時環境，能讓AI智能體在系統不停機前提下直接防護。其核心是讓AI智能體編寫動態eBPF防護規則，藉助eBPF在不修改內核的情況下實現運行時安全，避免系統裸奔或停機等待修復。

source_material.title: OpenAI 攜手思科開源 Shirudo：給 AI 智能體系統裝上“不打烊的防彈衣”
source_material.summary: 針對漏洞爆發至補丁落地間的防護真空期，OpenAI於11月24日聯合思科推出開源項目Shirudo。它是一款開源Linux運行時環境，能讓AI智能體在系統不停機前提下直接防護。其核心是讓AI智能體編寫動態eBPF防護規則，藉助eBPF在不修改內核的情況下實現運行時安全，避免系統裸奔或停機等待修復。

items.title: 騙子從郵件打到電話：微軟給 Teams 配了位 AI 反詐員
items.summary: 釣魚攻擊正從郵件轉向通話，冒充IT支持的來電更難識破。11月24日，據Neowin報道，微軟正爲Teams開發AI防詐騙功能，可在通話時分析聊天內容，識別潛在釣魚詐騙跡象並向用戶警告，尤其針對冒充IT管理員的話術。按微軟路線圖，該功能計劃2027年1月向所有用戶開放。

items.title: 補丁要等數週，防護今晚就能上線：OpenAI 攜手思科開源 Shirudo
items.summary: 11月23日，OpenAI與思科合作推出開源安全運行時Shirudo。企業修復Linux漏洞常需數天至數週，攻擊者卻不會等。Shirudo基於eBPF，爲運行中系統加裝無需重啓的臨時“盾牌”，持續觀察內核與網絡活動，精準管控可疑行爲，已通過Java4Shell攻擊攔截測試。難點在於漏報等問題。

items.title: 沒等股價起飛就落袋：Anthropic CEO 上市當天套現 2.8 億美元
items.summary: SEC檔案顯示，Anthropic CEO達裡奧·阿莫代伊在IPO上市當天出售337.8378萬股Class A普通股，每股83美元，套現約2.804億美元。值得注意的是，成交價正是IPO發行價；Anthropic上市首日曾大漲，此後幾日股價也高於發行價，他卻未以更高價減持，而是按發行價落袋為安。

items.title: AI 連代碼合入權都接走了：Anthropic 上線 Claude Ship

items.title: 谷歌讓 Gemini 4 智能體“開會”改造量子算法：最高提速 290 倍，還附帶數學正確性證明
items.summary: 量子計算存在算法瓶頸：重要應用即便用最優量子算法，資源需求仍遠超早期硬件。谷歌DeepMind與Google Quantum AI在11月23日發佈研究，提出用多個Gemini4智能體協同優化經典量子算法，生成高效量子電路。量子電路是量子計算機執行運算的基礎，該方案爲緩解算法與硬件資源矛盾提供新思路。

items.title: Yann LeCun 開砲，直指 Dario 誇大 AI 風險是為了讓開源模型違法、保住自己的掌控權
items.summary: Yann LeCun 在 X 上指控 Anthropic 執行長 Dario Amodei 渲染 AI 危險，是為了讓開放模型違法、保住掌控權。但引爆這波爭執的影片其實出自 2023 年參議院聽證，且被剪掉「目前開源風險有限」的段落；Anthropic 今年 7 月也已表態從未主張禁止開放權重。

items.title: datasette-agent 0.7a1
items.summary: Release: datasette-agent 0.7a1 I small improvement to Datasette Agent : chat sessions can open an iframe side panel, and that panel can then navigate to different pages. This version improves navigation by fragment hashes, for deeper integration with other Datasette plugins that update fragment hashes when the user interacts with the plugin in a way that changes state. I built this in order to fix some bugs with the much more exciting datasette-charts 0.2a0 release . Tags: datasette-agent , datasette

items.title: GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer
items.summary: GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer GLM 5.4 is now available from Chinese AI lab Z.ai. It's their first model to use a looped transformer architecture, which they describe like this: In a standard Transformer, each layer runs once per forward pass. In a Loop Transformer, a group of weight-shared layers runs for multiple iterations, refining the hidden states from the previous pass. This gives us a deeper network without increasing the parameter count. This is the second mention of looped transformers I've seen in the past week - the first was Inkling 2 Mini from Thinking Machines Lab on November 20th, who said: Inkling 2 Mini is a looped transformer, running the middle layers of the model three times for every token. This allows the model to apply more reasoning and reach the right answer with fewer tokens, especially on tasks such as agentic coding that depend on reasoning quality. GLM 5.4 is not (yet?) available as open weights. I tried it out using the Z.ai API, for which I had to sign up for their Coding Plan subscription because 5.4 cannot currently be accessed through the regular API. It turns out both coding plan and regular API share the same OpenAI-compatible Responses API (at https://api.z.ai/api/v1 ), and the API key for the coding plan worked with that and gave me access to the new model. I built a llm-glm plugin , then realized that llm-zai by Tommy Hughes already exists! I've shipped mine purely because llm-zai doesn't yet support the new model, but I'll likely retire mine once that plugin catches up. Here are pelicans for GLM-5.
items.summary_zh: GLM-5.4：透過我們第一個迴圈 Transformer 邁向廣義編碼 GLM 5.4 現已由中國 AI 實驗室 智譜 提供。這是他們第一個使用迴圈 Transformer 架構的模型，他們對此描述如下：在標準 Transformer 中，每一層在每個前向傳遞中執行一次。在迴圈 Transformer 中，一組權重共用層執行多次疊代，藉此精煉前一次傳遞的隱藏狀態。這讓我們在不增加參數數量的情況下獲得更深層的網路。這是我在過去一週內第二次看到關於迴圈 Transformer 的提及 - 第一次是 11 月 20 日來自 Thinking Machines Lab 的 Inkling 2 Mini，他們表示：Inkling 2 Mini 是一個迴圈 Transformer，為每個 Token 執行模型的中間層三次。這讓模型能夠應用更多推理，並以更少的 Token 達到正確答案，特別是在取決於推理品質的代理式編碼等任務上。GLM 5.4 （目前？）尚未以開源權重形式提供。我使用 智譜 API 進行了試用，為此我必須註冊他們的編碼計畫（Coding Plan）訂閱，因為 5.4 目前無法透過一般 API 存取。結果證明，編碼計畫和一般 API 共享相同的相容 OpenAI 的 Responses API（位於 https://api.z.ai/api/v1 ），而編碼計畫的 API 金鑰適用於該 API 並讓我能夠存取新模型。我建構了一個 llm-glm 外掛程式，然後才發現 Tommy Hughes 已經開發了 llm-zai！我推出自己的外掛程式純粹是因為 llm-zai 尚未支援新模型，但一旦該外掛程式跟進，我可能會讓我的外掛程式退役。以下是 GLM-5 的 pelicans。

In a Loop Transformer, a group of weight-shared layers runs for multiple iterations, refining the hidden states from the previous pass. This gives us a deeper network without increasing the parameter count. This is the second mention of looped transformers I've seen in the past week - the first was Inkling 2 Mini from Thinking Machines Lab on November 20th, who said: Inkling 2 Mini is a looped transformer, running the middle layers of the model three times for every token. This allows the model to apply more reasoning and reach the right answer with fewer tokens, especially on tasks such as agentic coding that depend on reasoning quality. GLM 5.4 is not (yet?) available as open weights. I tried it out using the Z.ai API, for which I had to sign up for their Coding Plan subscription because 5.4 cannot currently be accessed through the regular API. It turns out both coding plan and regular API share the same OpenAI-compatible Responses API (at https://api.z.ai/api/v1 ), and the API key for the coding plan worked with that and gave me access to the new model. I built a llm-glm plugin , then realized that llm-zai by Tommy Hughes already exists! I've shipped mine purely because llm-zai doesn't yet support the new model, but I'll likely retire mine once that plugin catches up. Here are pelicans for GLM-5.

items_ai.title: RoboTrack: Point tracking for real-world robotic manipulation
items_ai.reader_summary: Deploying robots in real-world settings requires reliable perception throughout an interaction. To pick something up, a robot needs to follow the positions of its gripper and the object as they move. In a laboratory, a robot handling a pipette must keep track of its tip while aligning it with the opening of a tube. These tasks become harder when nearby objects clutter the view, the gripper obscures the object being handled, or the viewing angle changes.
items_ai.summary_zh: 在真實世界環境中部署機器人，需要在整個互動過程中具備可靠的感知能力。為了撿起某樣東西，機器人需要追蹤其夾爪和物件在移動時的位置。在實驗室中，處理移液器的機器人必須在追蹤其尖端的同時，將其與試管口對齊。當鄰近物件幹擾視線、夾爪遮擋了正在處理的物件，或是視角改變時，這些任務會變得更加困難。

items_ai.title: Anthropic's appetite for compute is pushing xAI toward a rent-over-build strategy
items_ai.summary: Since May, SpaceXSI has been renting compute to competitors like Anthropic and Google while scaling back its own AI projects. Anthropic pays about $3.1 billion a month, Google $800 million, the New York Times reports. After its June IPO, SpaceXSI disbanded the 60-person Grok Imagine team, among other cuts. The article Anthropic's appetite for compute is pushing xAI toward a rent-over-build strategy appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 《紐約時報》報導，自 5 月以來，SpaceXSI 一邊縮減自身的 AI 專案規模，一邊將算力租給 Anthropic 和 Google 等競爭對手。Anthropic 每月支付約 31 億美元，Google 則支付 8.0 億美元。在 6 月份的首次公開募股（IPO）之後，SpaceXSI 解散了擁有 60 人的 Grok Imagine 團隊，並進行了其他裁員。

items_ai.title: OpenAI warns that upcoming AI systems could outpace safety checks and urges rivals to agree on shared limits
items_ai.summary: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki has released internal perplexity scores for the entire GPT series for the first time, up to an unreleased model beyond the current generation. The metric shows that core capabilities emerge at surprisingly precise thresholds. Pachocki is pushing to make perplexity an industry-wide progress metric and establish shared limits before control over AI behavior erodes. The article OpenAI warns that upcoming AI systems could outpace safety checks and urges rivals to agree on shared limits appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: OpenAI 首席科學家 Jakub Pachocki 首次發布了整個 GPT 系列（包含一個超越當前世代的未發布模型）的內部困惑度（perplexity）分數。該指標顯示核心能力會在令人驚訝的精確閾值處浮現。Pachocki 正積極推動將困惑度訂為全產業的進度指標，並在對 AI 行為的控制力消逝之前建立共同的限制。

items_ai.title: Z.ai follows OpenAI into loop transformer territory with its new 750B flagship model
items_ai.summary: Z.ai is moving its flagship GLM-5.4 model to a loop architecture in which 28 layers run twice, which the company says lets the 750-billion-parameter model match models with 2 to 3 trillion parameters. Benchmark scores are only available for a smaller 30B test model so far, and Z.ai is positioning GLM-5.4 as the start of "Generalized Coding," where code also generates videos, games, and CAD models. The article Z.ai follows OpenAI into loop transformer territory with its new 750B flagship model appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 智譜 正在將其旗艦 GLM-5.4 模型轉移到循環架構中，其中 28 層會執行兩次，該公司表示這讓這個擁有 7,500 億參數的模型能夠匹敵擁有 2 兆到 3 兆參數的模型。目前基準測試分數僅適用於較小的 30B 測試模型，且 智譜 正將 GLM-5.4 定位為「廣義編碼（Generalized Coding）」的開端，程式碼在此也能生成影片、遊戲和 CAD 模型。

items_ai.title: US spies tracked Nvidia scandal figure's ties to Chinese intelligence for over a year
items_ai.summary: US intelligence agencies tracked contacts between Alice Huang and China's Ministry of State Security for over a year, the New York Times reports. The surveillance ran parallel to her secret affair with then-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. Federal investigators are now looking into whether a network of companies in Southeast Asia was used to smuggle AI chips into China in violation of US export controls. Jensen Huang is scheduled to testify before the US House of Representatives on December 1. The article US spies tracked Nvidia scandal figure's ties to Chinese intelligence for over a year appeared first on The Decoder .

items_ai.title: Demo 剛公開就被抄上小程序：一款用AI開發獨遊靠中國玩家扳回兩局
items_ai.summary: 2025年10月，一個不會編程、畫畫的年輕人用AI做遊戲，首條指令是“做一個能用WASD移動的方塊遊戲”。一年後，其一人團隊Optima Arch的《轉運軍團》（slotbound）爆賣：11月13日42元首發九折，6天銷量破20萬套，銷售額近千萬，1800多條評測約80%好評，最高同時在線3.3萬。商店頁坦承視覺與宣傳物料由AI生成，呈現“AI畫皮、人寫骨”模式。

items_ai.title: 黃仁勳官復原職：英偉達董事會一週內戲劇性逆轉，股價應聲大漲 31%
items_ai.summary: 英偉達圍繞最高權力的拉鋸不到一週徹底反轉。董事會一致投票通過，恢復黃仁勳總裁、CEO及董事職務；消息公佈後，公司股價隨即大漲31%。而幾天前，董事長哈維·瓊斯還向投資者明確表示，董事會無意讓黃仁勳迴歸。董事會解釋，促成逆轉的是幾股力量同時到位，後續會談讓他們對黃仁勳的態度發生改變。

items_ai.title: OpenAI 攜手思科開源 Shirudo：給 AI 智能體系統裝上“不打烊的防彈衣”
items_ai.summary: 針對漏洞爆發至補丁落地間的防護真空期，OpenAI於11月24日聯合思科推出開源項目Shirudo。它是一款開源Linux運行時環境，能讓AI智能體在系統不停機前提下直接防護。其核心是讓AI智能體編寫動態eBPF防護規則，藉助eBPF在不修改內核的情況下實現運行時安全，避免系統裸奔或停機等待修復。

items_ai.title: 谷歌讓 Gemini 4 智能體“開會”改造量子算法：最高提速 290 倍，還附帶數學正確性證明
items_ai.summary: 量子計算存在算法瓶頸：重要應用即便用最優量子算法，資源需求仍遠超早期硬件。谷歌DeepMind與Google Quantum AI在11月23日發佈研究，提出用多個Gemini4智能體協同優化經典量子算法，生成高效量子電路。量子電路是量子計算機執行運算的基礎，該方案爲緩解算法與硬件資源矛盾提供新思路。

items_ai.summary: Release: datasette-agent 0.7a1 I small improvement to Datasette Agent : chat sessions can open an iframe side panel, and that panel can then navigate to different pages. This version improves navigation by fragment hashes, for deeper integration with other Datasette plugins that update fragment hashes when the user interacts with the plugin in a way that changes state. items_ai.title: GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer
items_ai.summary: GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer GLM 5.4 is now available from Chinese AI lab Z.ai. It's their first model to use a looped transformer architecture, which they describe like this: In a standard Transformer, each layer runs once per forward pass. In a Loop Transformer, a group of weight-shared layers runs for multiple iterations, refining the hidden states from the previous pass. This gives us a deeper network without increasing the parameter count. This is the second mention of looped transformers I've seen in the past week - the first was Inkling 2 Mini from Thinking Machines Lab on November 20th, who said: Inkling 2 Mini is a looped transformer, running the middle layers of the model three times for every token. This allows the model to apply more reasoning and reach the right answer with fewer tokens, especially on tasks such as agentic coding that depend on reasoning quality. GLM 5.4 is not (yet?) available as open weights. I tried it out using the Z.ai API, for which I had to sign up for their Coding Plan subscription because 5.4 cannot currently be accessed through the regular API. It turns out both coding plan and regular API share the same OpenAI-compatible Responses API (at https://api.z.ai/api/v1 ), and the API key for the coding plan worked with that and gave me access to the new model. I built a llm-glm plugin , then realized that llm-zai by Tommy Hughes already exists! I've shipped mine purely because llm-zai doesn't yet support the new model, but I'll likely retire mine once that plugin catches up. Here are pelicans for GLM-5.
items_ai.summary_zh: GLM-5.4：透過我們第一個迴圈 Transformer 邁向廣義編碼 GLM 5.4 現已由中國 AI 實驗室 智譜 提供。這是他們第一個使用迴圈 Transformer 架構的模型，他們對此描述如下：在標準 Transformer 中，每一層在每個前向傳遞中執行一次。在迴圈 Transformer 中，一組權重共用層執行多次疊代，藉此精煉前一次傳遞的隱藏狀態。這讓我們在不增加參數數量的情況下獲得更深層的網路。這是我在過去一週內第二次看到關於迴圈 Transformer 的提及 - 第一次是 11 月 20 日來自 Thinking Machines Lab 的 Inkling 2 Mini，他們表示：Inkling 2 Mini 是一個迴圈 Transformer，為每個 Token 執行模型的中間層三次。這讓模型能夠應用更多推理，並以更少的 Token 達到正確答案，特別是在取決於推理品質的代理式編碼等任務上。GLM 5.4 （目前？）尚未以開源權重形式提供。我使用 智譜 API 進行了試用，為此我必須註冊他們的編碼計畫（Coding Plan）訂閱，因為 5.4 目前無法透過一般 API 存取。結果證明，編碼計畫和一般 API 共享相同的相容 OpenAI 的 Responses API（位於 https://api.z.ai/api/v1 ），而編碼計畫的 API 金鑰適用於該 API 並讓我能夠存取新模型。我建構了一個 llm-glm 外掛程式，然後才發現 Tommy Hughes 已經開發了 llm-zai！我推出自己的外掛程式純粹是因為 llm-zai 尚未支援新模型，但一旦該外掛程式跟進，我可能會讓我的外掛程式退役。以下是 GLM-5 的 pelicans。

spans.text: GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer

GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer GLM 5.4 is now available from Chinese AI lab Z.ai. It's their first model to use a looped transformer architecture, which they describe like this: In a standard Transformer, each layer runs once per forward pass. In a Loop Transformer, a group of weight-shared layers runs for multiple iterations, refining the hidden states from the previous pass. This gives us a deeper network without increasing the parameter count. This is the second mention of looped transformers I've seen in the past week - the first was Inkling 2 Mini from Thinking Machines Lab on November 20th, who said: Inkling 2 Mini is a looped transformer, running the middle layers of the model three times for every token. This allows the model to apply more reasoning and reach the right answer with fewer tokens, especially on tasks such as agentic coding that depend on reasoning quality. GLM 5.4 is not (yet?) available as open weights. I tried it out using the Z.ai API, for which I had to sign up for their Coding Plan subscription because 5.4 cannot currently be accessed through the regular API. It turns out both coding plan and regular API share the same OpenAI-compatible Responses API (at https://api.z.ai/api/v1 ), and the API key for the coding plan worked with that and gave me access to the new model. I built a llm-glm plugin , then realized that llm-zai by Tommy Hughes already exists! I've shipped mine purely because llm-zai doesn't yet support the new model, but I'll likely retire mine once that plugin catches up. Here are pelicans for GLM-5.
